major.summary: The PostgreSQL malformed-timestamp guard still needs a guaranteed non-throwing expression shape.
major.evidence: SQL predicate evaluation order is not guaranteed, so an AND chain around pg_input_is_valid and timestamptz casts can still throw.
major.impact: A malformed historical timestamp could abort a repeated-signal decision instead of failing closed to suppression.
major.recommendation: Require one CASE WHEN expression with casts only in the THEN branch, and a repository-write test proving malformed PostgreSQL values suppress without throwing.
